dct_creator_sm: Pandey, Neem (Department of Plant Agriculture. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph., University of Guelph).
dct_description_sm: As part of the "Soil health assessment and cover crops for the Holland Marsh" thesis research, canopy coverage, plant counts, and biomass produced by biofumigant cover crops were assessed to evaluate their establishment. Additionally carrot yield in 2022 after biofumigant cover crops in 2021 was assessed.
dct_title_s: Soil health assessment and cover crops for the Holland Marsh: Biofumigant cover crops
